sights.name: Marché des Enfants Rouges
sights.blurb: Paris's oldest covered market (1628), with food stalls for lunch or dinner. Closed Mondays.

sights.name: Musée Picasso
sights.blurb: The world's largest Picasso collection, in a 17th-century mansion. Likely free on Sun 6 Dec (first Sunday). Closed Mondays.

sights.name: Musée Carnavalet
sights.blurb: The history of Paris, from shop signs to Proust's bedroom. Always free.

sights.name: Place des Vosges
sights.blurb: Paris's oldest planned square, ringed with arcades and cafés.

sights.name: Rue des Rosiers · L'As du Fallafel
sights.blurb: The famous falafel of the Jewish quarter. Closed Saturdays, open Sundays.

sights.name: Canal Saint-Martin
sights.blurb: Iron footbridges and locks. A good evening walk with bars along the quays.

sights.name: Hôtel de Ville & the Seine
sights.blurb: City Hall and the river. An easy first-night walk.

sights.name: Notre-Dame
sights.blurb: Free to enter. Reserve a timeslot online to skip the line.

sights.name: Sainte-Chapelle
sights.blurb: Floor-to-ceiling 13th-century stained glass. €22 non-EU, timed slot.

sights.name: Shakespeare and Company
sights.blurb: The famous English bookshop facing Notre-Dame, at the edge of the Latin Quarter.

sights.name: Louvre
sights.blurb: €32 non-EU with a timed slot. Closed Tuesdays, open late on Fridays.

sights.name: Tuileries & Orangerie
sights.blurb: Monet's water lilies. Free on Sun 6 Dec with a booked slot. Closed Tuesdays.

sights.name: Musée d'Orsay
sights.blurb: Impressionists in an old train station. Free on Sun 6 Dec with a booked slot. Closed Mondays.

sights.name: Galeries Lafayette
sights.blurb: The giant Christmas tree under the glass dome, and a free rooftop view.

sights.name: Opéra Garnier
sights.blurb: The grand opera house, next door to Galeries Lafayette.

sights.name: Sacré-Cœur & Montmartre
sights.blurb: A free basilica with the best view over Paris. Climb the steps or take the funicular (one metro ticket).

sights.name: Arc de Triomphe & Champs-Élysées
sights.blurb: Rooftop view down the lit-up Champs-Élysées. Reported free on first Sundays Nov–Mar.

sights.name: Eiffel Tower
sights.blurb: Summit €36.70 by lift, €28 with stairs to the 2nd floor. It sparkles on the hour after dark.

sights.name: Trocadéro
sights.blurb: The classic photo spot facing the tower across the river.

via: Parvis des Libertés et des Droits de l'Homme
Parvis des Libertés et des Droits de l'Homme

sights.name: Gare du Nord (Eurostar)
sights.blurb: Where the Eurostar arrives on Wed 2 Dec. Coming from here, ride line 5 the other way, toward Place d'Italie.
